Enable BB 00 01 B1 01 0A (xor BB^01^B1^01 = 0A): uwAB + B1010A = 101100|010000|000100|001010 = s Q E K -> uwABsQEK. Disable BB 00 01 B1 00 0B: uwAB + B1000B = 101100|010000|000000|001011 = s Q A L -> uwABsQAL.
